Trigger
● FAIRsFAIR, EOSC-Nordic and SSHOC
repository support initiatives seeking to
sustain the efforts.

Today’s objective
● Explore ideas and needs of such a network.

Proposed outcome
● Identify steps to progress towards a European
TDR network.

--- Page 9 ---
Potential value of the network

For repositories:
• Promote adoption of FAIR and TRUST practices
• Strengthen the voice of TDRs in Europe

For researchers:
• Facilitate researchers’ access to Long Term Preservation

For the EOSC:
• Enhance repository compliance with EOSC RoP
• Help implement FAIR and TRUST assessments
